Our invention relates to the production of
methanol by the high pressure catalytic com-
bination of oxides of carbon with hydrogen,
and pertains more directly to the prepara-
tion and employment of improved catalysts
in the process. a

oxides of carbon with hydrogen in the pres-

perature and pressure. Carbon monoxide, |
